_readme: Open-mic classification rules, applied by scripts/fetch-events.js at ingest.
Every event in events.json gets an explicit `is_open_mic` boolean so the
WordPress plugin and front-end JS no longer guess from the title string
'open mic' (which only ever matched The Secret Group's series names and
made /open-mics/ a one-venue page).
An event is flagged is_open_mic=true when ANY of these hold:
1. Its title contains 'open mic' (hyphens normalized to spaces) — the
legacy rule, kept because it is reliable when it does match.
2. It matches an enabled entry in `series_allowlist` below: title_match
is a case-insensitive substring of the event title, and venue_match
(if present) a case-insensitive substring of the venue name. Use
this for recurring mic series whose names don't say 'open mic'.
series_allowlist — recurring mics already present in the Ticketmaster/
Eventbrite feeds under a series name. Add one entry per series.
Fields: title_match (required), venue_match (optional), enabled
(optional, default true), note.
manual_mics — recurring weekly bar mics the import can't see (no
Eventbrite/Ticketmaster listing). Each enabled entry is expanded
into dated occurrences (one per week through the fetch window) and
appended to events.json with source='manual', price 0, and
is_open_mic=true. If an API event flagged as an open mic exists at
the same venue+date, the manual occurrence is dropped for that date
so a show is never listed twice — which is also why The Secret
Group's six weekly mics (Speedball, Comedy Dojo, Night Court, Pass
the Mic, Witchy Wednesdays, Back of the Bus) have no entries here:
they already arrive via the Eventbrite feed. Fields:
name         — event title as it should render on the site
venue        — venue name (add aliases in venues.json if needed)
venue_city   — city, e.g. 'Houston'
day_of_week  — 'Monday' … 'Sunday'
time         — '8:00 PM' style 12-hour string
info_url     — venue/series page for the card's outbound link (optional)
image_url    — card image (optional)
description  — sign-up details: list vs bucket, sign-up time, set length (optional)
age_restriction — e.g. '21+' (optional)
enabled      — set false to stop generating occurrences without
deleting the entry (mic on hiatus, bi-weekly
schedule that weekly expansion would overstate, …)
Seeded 2026-07-24 from the community 'Houston Comedy Open Mics'
schedule graphic (last updated 7/15/26). Times are PM as listed there.
These entries have NO organizer feed behind them — if a mic moves or
dies, nothing here updates itself. Re-check against the community mic
map periodically and fill in info_url/description/sign-up details as
they're verified.

series_allowlist.note: Weekly free bar series from the Social Comedy Night organizer — Notsuoh (Tue 10pm), Big Ben Tavern (Tue 8pm), Social Beer Garden HTX (Thu 9pm). NOT on the community mic list, so it may be a booked showcase rather than a sign-up mic — verify before enabling. Either way it stays on /free/ via its $0 price.
